items.title: Claude Sonnet 5 Launched Feb 3 — Codename 'Fennec', Already Topping Benchmarks
items.summary: Anthropic quietly released Claude Sonnet 5 on February 3, codenamed 'Fennec'. Prediction markets now show 54% probability of a full Claude 5 family by end of March. The model was first spotted in Google Vertex AI logs. Mashable and Dataconomy confirmed the launch, with early benchmarks showing strong gains over Sonnet 4.
items.relevance: Sonnet 5 is now live. This is the mid-tier model — likely faster and cheaper than Opus 4.6 for everyday coding tasks. Worth testing for AVA development workflows where speed matters more than max capability

items.title: Claude Code v2.1.21 — Agent Teams, Opus 4.6 Support, Task System Overhaul
items.summary: Claude Code's latest release adds experimental Agent Teams (multi-agent collaboration with team leads and shared task lists, enable with CLAUDE_CODE_EXPERIMENTAL_AGENT_TEAMS=1), native Opus 4.6 support with 1M token context, customizable keybindings, task management with dependency tracking, and VSCode plugin support. Also fixes session compaction, MCP Unicode handling, and background agent permissions.
items.relevance: Agent Teams is the big one — imagine one agent on SwiftUI, another on ESP32 firmware, another on tests, all coordinated. Task dependency tracking also useful for complex AVA feature branches

items.title: Dexcom Adds AI-Powered Smart Meal Logging to Stelo OTC CGM
items.summary: Dexcom announced an AI-enhanced Smart Food Logging feature for its Stelo over-the-counter CGM. Users can now log meals with AI assistance that estimates carb counts and correlates glucose responses. Stelo is Dexcom's consumer-grade CGM that doesn't require a prescription.
items.relevance: Direct competition validation for AVA's carb-tracking features. Dexcom adding AI meal logging to their OTC CGM proves the market wants smarter food → glucose correlation. AVA's simulation could model this same concept for learning

items.title: Insulet Launches Omnipod 5 + Omnipod Discover in the Middle East
items.summary: Insulet expanded Omnipod 5 and the new Omnipod Discover platform to Saudi Arabia, Kuwait, UAE, and Qatar. The system pairs with both Abbott Libre 2 Plus and Dexcom G7 sensors. Omnipod 5 is cleared for ages 2+ with T1D — same system Kam uses.
items.relevance: Your pump system going global — Omnipod 5 expanding internationally means more families worldwide who could benefit from AVA's educational tools. Also validates Omnipod's dominance in tubeless delivery

items.title: Insulin Pump Market Projected to Hit $25.4B by 2033 — CGM Integration Driving Growth
items.summary: New market analysis from Astute Analytica projects the insulin pump market reaching $25.4 billion by 2033, driven by CGM sensor integration, auto-calibration features, and real-time dosing algorithms. Collaboration between pump and sensor makers is accelerating innovation.
items.relevance: $25B market by 2033 = massive opportunity for education tools. Every new pump user needs to learn how the technology works. AVA is positioned exactly where the growth is — teaching the next generation of pump users

items.title: India AI Impact Summit Next Week — 100 Countries, Pichai, Gates, Jensen, Altman All Attending
items.summary: The largest-ever global AI summit kicks off Feb 16-20 in New Delhi with 100+ countries, 15+ heads of state, and 100+ CEOs. Confirmed speakers include Sundar Pichai, Bill Gates, Jensen Huang. Sam Altman reportedly attending closed-door meetings. India is pushing an 'impact-first' AI governance agenda focused on the Global South.
items.source: India Today / Business Standard / DQ India
items.relevance: Watch next week for major announcements — every major AI leader in one room. Pichai could drop Gemini updates, Jensen may reveal Vera Rubin pricing, and Altman's closed-door meetings suggest OpenAI has something cooking

items.title: OpenAI GPT-5.3-Codex + Standalone Mac Coding App — Direct Salvo at Claude Code
items.summary: OpenAI launched GPT-5.3-Codex (their best coding model yet) alongside a standalone Codex Mac app that can 'build complex apps from scratch over days.' Released within minutes of Opus 4.6 to maximize competitive impact. CNBC reports it's specifically targeting Anthropic and Cursor's developer audience.
items.relevance: The AI coding war benefits builders like you — more competition means better tools, faster. Worth trying the Codex Mac app for quick prototyping sessions when you want something lighter than full Claude Code

items.title: Dexcom CEO: Diabetics on GLP-1s Should Also Wear CGMs
items.summary: Dexcom CEO Jake Leach is pushing for CGM adoption among the growing GLP-1 user base, arguing that even patients using Ozempic/Wegovy for diabetes management benefit from continuous glucose monitoring. This positions CGMs not just for insulin-dependent diabetics but for the broader metabolic health market.
items.relevance: Dexcom expanding CGM beyond T1D into the GLP-1 crowd massively grows the addressable market for glucose education. AVA's learning tools could adapt for Type 2 and metabolic health audiences down the road
